text: Why it's laggy: everything goes through GitHub. The engine can push its status to GitHub at most every 8 s (GitHub throttles faster pushes), then your phone read it every 5 s: so 8-13 s behind, plus the old frozen status after a restart. Doing now: phone reads every 2 s while the app is open (unchanged answers are free), and the stale/quiet/stalled warnings. That gets you to about 8-10 s behind, which is GitHub's floor. For TRULY live (under 2 s) there's one option: the engine opens a free Cloudflare 'quick tunnel' (no account, no cost) and the phone connects straight to the running engine for its status/progress, falling back to GitHub if it fails. That relays the (already public) status through Cloudflare, so it's your call: say 'tunnel yes' and I'll build it.
